question: What happens to one in whom this yoga has matured, even while still embodied?
premises: Such a person may still be seen by ordinary people and remain in the condition of bodily bondage.
When yoga has matured in him, his state changes inwardly.
He attains an extraordinary awareness in an instant.
inference: Even while outwardly embodied and observed, one in whom yoga has matured instantly attains a special awareness.
uncertainties: The phrase 'na kṣaṇāt kām api saṃvidam' is syntactically compressed; the sense taken is that he attains an incomparable awareness in a moment.
plain_english: Even while being seen by people and remaining in the condition of bodily bondage, when yoga has matured he attains in an instant an incomparable awareness.
